Society & Human Rights.title: Christa Pike left in ‘critical condition’ as Tennessee halts all executions | First Thing
Society & Human Rights.text: Failed attempt to execute 50-year-old prompts review of state’s execution practices. Plus the California woman who is allergic to coldGood morning. Tennessee’s governor has suspended executions as Christa Pike’s lawyer says the state’s failed lethal injection execution attempt has left her in a critical condition. Bill Lee, the Republican state governor, has suspended all executions in the state until at least the end of the year and ordered an independent inquiry.Leading voices on the death penalty in the US have told the Guardian that the failed execution was such a violation of the constitutional prohibition on “cruel and unusual punishment” that all judicial killings should be halted nationwide.What have Pike’s lawyers said about her condition? Randy Spivey, one of her attorneys, said: “We don’t have a sense of her prognosis or much update on her health at the moment, but we do know that she is alive right now and receiving life-saving medical care. She is in a critical condition.”What did witnesses say took place during the execution attempt? Catherine Sweeney, a reporter at the Nashville Public Radio WPLN, said: “They went through two rounds, and she was still breathing at the end. She was very ragged. She lifted her head up and was looking around. At one point, she said … there was a spot that was burning and hurting, and asked if that was normal. None of it was normal.”What was Pike convicted of? She was convicted of the brutal 1995 killing of Colleen Slemmer, alongside her then boyfriend, Tadaryl Shipp. Lee said he had not yet spoken to Slemmer’s family after the failed execution.Why has the DNC issued a lawsuit against the administration? The Trump administration broke the law when it pushed through a last-minute change to the form overseas citizens use to register and request absentee ballots, the Democratic National Committee (DNC) said in a lawsuit filed on Thursday. “Trump and Republicans are so desperate to hang on to power that they are trying to eliminate the way some American citizens abroad register to vote and request mail ballots,” said Ken Martin, the chair of the DNC.Which states are leading the resistance to the Trump EPA’s repeal of emissions rules? Twenty-one states, led by New York, are challenging the Environmental Protection Agency’s power plant rule. The New York attorney general, Letitia James, said the federal government was showing “callous disregard” for Americans’ health and the environment, and future generations would pay the price. Power plants that burn fossil fuels are a major source of planet-warming pollution. Continue reading...

Artificial Intelligence.title: Sony Releases QSSR AI Upscaling for the Base PS5, Bringing Sharper Visuals Without a Pro Upgrade
Artificial Intelligence.text: SummarySony drops QSSR, bringing AI-driven upscaling directly to the base PlayStation 5 architectureThe AMD-backed tech arrives first on 'Marvel’s Wolverine' and 'Ghost of Yōtei' via October 1 patchesQSSR offers a software-level alternative to the hardware-accelerated upscaling previously locked behind the premium PS5 ProSony officially leveled the playing field for the base console generation with the launch of Quick Spectral Super Resolution (QSSR). This AI graphics upscaling technology is engineered specifically for the standard PlayStation 5. The current console life cycle has been consistently held back by low resolution outputs and poor upscaling solutions because the original architecture lacks dedicated machine learning chips. Sony bridges that gap by providing a scalable software alternative to the hardware-accelerated upscaling previously locked behind the premium Pro model. Project Amethyst served as the internal banner for the breakthrough partnership with AMD.PlayStation Spectral Super Resolution (PSSR) remains the gold standard according to official brand statements. Because the base hardware is missing dedicated machine learning silicon, QSSR operates at a slightly slower pace than its Pro-level counterpart. Standard rigs can expect the technology to hit an upscaled 1440p resolution instead of pushing the upscaled 4K visuals seen on advanced hardware. Principal graphics R&D engineer Daniel Craig stressed that developers must stay flexible to maximize the software. Studios carefully tune their render resolutions alongside presentation targets based on the active graphics mode.Implementing the upgrade is designed to be largely frictionless for the industry despite the required tuning. Quick Spectral Super Resolution acts as a straightforward drop-in replacement for any title that already supports PSSR. Sony confirmed the toolkit will be offered broadly to all developers moving forward. The rollout officially kicked off on October 1 when Marvel’s Wolverine and Ghost of Yōtei became the first games to receive patches. Video demonstrations of the two titles utilizing the update highlighted a visual presentation with slightly sharper graphics across the board.Heavyweight attention is already following the immediate impact of the update across the technical gaming space. Digital Foundry stated that QSSR has the potential to make a big difference for a console generation weighed down by low-resolution struggles. This assessment followed an early hands-on review of the technology authored by Richard Leadbetter. Sony is ensuring its massive player community is not left behind as visual demands continue to push forward. Science & Technology.title: Engineering Multipole Resonances in Dielectric Metasurfaces for Transmission, Reflection, and Absorption Control
Science & Technology.text: Dielectric metasurfaces have moved to the forefront of nanophotonics, offering flat, low-loss alternatives to conventional bulk optical elements for controlling the amplitude, phase, and polarization of light. These structures are of growing interest to researchers and engineers working on sensing, energy harvesting, and flat optics, as their performance hinges on precisely engineered optical resonances. Full-wave finite element simulation, combined with semianalytical multipole decomposition in the COMSOL Multiphysics® software, gives us a way to not only predict these resonances but also uncover their underlying physical origins.In this webinar, Dr. Pavel Terekhov, postdoctoral researcher at National Institute of Standards and Technology, will trace how a single quadrumer meta-atom, originally studied for its magnetic octupole response, evolves into two distinct light manipulation regimes. He will first revisit the foundational single-particle results that motivated this work, then show how arranging quadrumers into a periodic crystalline silicon metasurface produces anomalous absorption enhancement, governed by two independent multipole mechanisms coexisting in the same structure. Building on this, he will then introduce ongoing work on a gallium nitride metasurface, where the complex interplay of four different multipoles is used to sculpt reflection and transmission spectra including the quasi-bound-states-in-the-continuum (q-BIC) manipulation.Attendees will see how COMSOL Multiphysics® and multipole decomposition connect full-wave simulation and analytical insight, turning abstract resonance behavior into physically interpretable design rules. The broader takeaway is that multipole-based simulation is not just a diagnostic tool but a design strategy: It enables the on-demand tailoring of absorption, reflection, and transmission in dielectric metasurfaces, with direct relevance to sensing, energy harvesting, and future optical device applications.Key Takeaways:Learn about modeling multipole resonances in dielectric metasurfaces using full-wave finite element simulation and semianalytical multipole decomposition in COMSOL Multiphysics®.See how multipole-based simulation can be used to understand and control absorption, reflection, and transmission in silicon and gallium nitride metasurfaces.Explore how different multipole mechanisms, including quasi-bound states in the continuum (q-BICs), can be engineered to tailor optical responses for sensing, energy harvesting, and flat optics.Gain insights into how simulation and multipole decomposition can help researchers and engineers turn complex resonance behavior into practical design strategies for future optical devices.Register now for this free webinar!

Science & Technology.title: Technics' EAH-A1000 Is a Hi-Fi Speaker Squeezed Into a Pair of Headphones
Science & Technology.text: SummaryTechnics has unveiled the EAH-A1000, a new flagship wireless over-ear built around a newly developed 40 mm Magnetic Fluid DriverSpeaker-derived tech including an SST Edge and a cone-shaped carbon fiber diaphragm targets lower distortion and a bigger soundstageA new Flow Arm design, re-engineered fit and up to 45 hours of playback round out the package in Black and a new Platinum GreigeTechnics has introduced the EAH-A1000, its new flagship wireless headphones, centered on a newly developed 40 mm Magnetic Fluid Driver. The over-ear model pulls acoustic engineering from the brand's speaker division into personal audio, pairing it with a next-generation Adaptive Noise Cancelling system and a newly designed Flow Arm headband.The driver is the core of the build. Bigger drivers deliver more scale, but they are also harder to keep in check, since any tilt, wobble or bending in the diaphragm translates into distortion. Technics' answer is magnetic fluid, a material that behaves as both a magnet and a liquid. Sitting between the voice coil and the driver magnet, it steadies the diaphragm's motion and dampens stray vibration. The approach isn't new to the brand, which previously used magnetic fluid tech in its in-ear models, including the EAH-TZ700 and EAH-AZ100, but this marks its jump to a full-size over-ear driver.Supporting that driver is an SST (Symmetrical Surround Technology) Edge, a component lifted from Technics' Hi-Fi flagship speakers. By making the surround's forward and backward travel more symmetrical as it holds the diaphragm, the edge cuts down on distortion. The diaphragm itself is carbon fiber, chosen for being light and stiff, and shaped as a cone to resist flexing across its larger surface. Technics labels it "Pure Carbon Fiber," a term the brand uses to describe a non-composite, non-laminated construction rather than one made solely from carbon fiber. The combined goal is fast, stable driver response that keeps bass weighty and the soundstage open.The acoustic path has been reworked to protect what the driver produces on its way to the ear. A new Baffle Flat Structure smooths out the surfaces surrounding the driver, cutting reflections that can blur imaging. Behind the driver, an Acoustic Control Chamber regulates airflow to keep low and midrange frequencies in balance so no single band dominates.Noise cancelling is handled by an adaptive system that tunes itself to both the surrounding environment and how the headphones sit on the wearer's head. Each ear cup carries three feed-forward microphones and one feedback microphone, eight in total, working together to catch and suppress noise arriving from multiple directions. Calls get their own treatment through AI Beamforming.The design marks a visual reset for the flagship. The new Flow Arm shifts from a square profile at the slider to a triangular one at the hanger, and its single-sided support gives Technics' signature round housings a lighter, more streamlined look. Metal is used for the arm and the top panels of each housing, finished to show off the raw material, and the brand's familiar circular machining carries over. The headphones fold down and ship with a dedicated carrying case.Comfort has been rebuilt from the ground up. A wider, optimized range of ear cup movement, a reshaped headband and finer slider adjustment spread pressure more evenly across different head shapes, while high-density memory foam ear pads aim to hold up over long sessions without sacrificing softness.On the connectivity side, the EAH-A1000 supports high-resolution playback via LDAC and lossless listening via USB Audio, along with Dolby Atmos optimization with head tracking. Battery life reaches up to 45 hours of continuous playback, and multipoint pairing handles up to three devices at once. Controls stick to physical buttons and a slide control, and the Technics Audio Connect app adds a Sound Share feature. Two colorways are available: Black and Platinum Greige, a new soft blend of gray and beige for the line.The A1000 is available for purchase now via Technics.Click here to view full gallery at Hypebeast

Entertainment.text: SummaryZara and John Galliano have officially released their debut collaborative collection titled Re{form} Vol 1The genderless lineup uses couture techniques to dismantle and reassemble archival Zara garmentsShot by Steven Meisel the inaugural drop is available now via Zara's webstoreZara and legendary couturier John Galliano have officially launched their inaugural collaboration, introducing a genderless collection titled "Re{form}" Vol. 1. Captured in a campaign shot by photographer Steven Meisel, the release sees archival Zara garments dismantled, distorted, and reconstructed through high-fashion couture techniques.Functioning as a creative exchange between the former Maison Margiela creative director and Zara’s historical wardrobe archives, the collection treats mass-market pieces as raw prototypes. Galliano cuts, splices, shrinks, and reassembles foundational garments into entirely new silhouettes. Conceptually, the design language draws inspiration from "Les Incroyables" and "Les Merveilleuses" of post-Revolutionary France, alongside elements of traditional gardening wardrobes and film noir aesthetics.Key transformations throughout the lineup reimagine staple items in unexpected ways. An oversized Zara button-up shirt features a foil print designed to resemble a leather coat, while a lace shift dress is repurposed into a ruffled collar. Elsewhere, tailored jackets incorporate re-positioned pockets for an expressive attitude, and multi-layered dresses are engineered to create the visual illusion of structured coats.The Zara by John Galliano "Re{form}" Vol. 1 collection is available now via Zara.Click here to view full gallery at Hypebeast

First debuted during the Fall/Winter 2026 Womenswear runway show in Paris, the joint design translates outdoor-inspired motifs into a forward-thinking eyewear piece.Drawing visual inspiration from nature, the frame's two distinct colorways—"Brown Smoke Wood" and "Amherst Fade"—translate organic feather and wood grain textures directly onto the silhouette. Constructed from Oakley's signature lightweight O Matter™ material, the frames are paired with no-slip Unobtainium® earsocks and customizable Unobtainium® nose pieces to ensure secure, all-day wearability.Technologically, the Ellipse frame utilizes PhysioMorphic™ Geometry to achieve its distinctive, fluid lens curvature. Entertainment.title: Sia Sells 50% Stake in Music Catalog to Pophouse in $180 Million USD Deal
Entertainment.text: SummarySia has sold a 50% stake in her publishing and master music catalog to Sweden-based investment firm Pophouse for $180 million USDThe transaction covers iconic hits including Chandelier Titanium and Cheap Thrills alongside future creative projectsThe acquisition was completed through Pophouse Fund I which previously raised over €1.2 billion EUR in total capitalPophouse Entertainment has officially acquired a 50% stake in the publishing and master music rights of Australian singer-songwriter Sia in a deal valued at $180 million USD. The partnership sees the Sweden-based entertainment and music investment firm step in to steward her body of work while developing new creative ventures surrounding her discography.The $180 million USD transaction encompasses major milestones across Sia's catalog, including chart-topping tracks like "Chandelier," "Titanium," "Cheap Thrills," "Unstoppable," and "Elastic Heart." According to reports, $165 million USD of the payment applies to works composed prior to her marriage to Dan Bernad, while $15 million USD for songs written during their marriage will be held in escrow until divorce terms are finalized.Reflecting on the milestone partnership, Sia expressed her enthusiasm for the collaboration: “I’m really excited to be working with Pophouse. These songs mean so much to me, and I love that they really understand that and want to take care of them. I’ve been making music for a very long time now, and it feels exciting to think about all the new and different ways these songs might get to live on and find people. I’m really looking forward to seeing what we can dream up together.”The acquisition was financed through Pophouse Fund I, which closed reaching its €1 billion EUR hard cap alongside additional co-investment vehicles bringing total capital raised to over €1.2 billion EUR. Co-founded by ABBA’s Bjorn Ulvaeus, Pophouse’s high-profile holdings also feature catalogs from Iron Maiden, Tina Turner, Kiss, Cyndi Lauper, Avicii, and Swedish House Mafia.Further creative developments and brand ventures under the new partnership are expected to be announced by Sia and Pophouse.Click here to view full gallery at Hypebeast

Entertainment.title: A24 Just Dropped the Most Robert Pattinson Collectible Imaginable
Entertainment.text: SummaryA24 has turned Robert Pattinson's run of roles with the studio into a six-piece set of nesting dollsEach doll depicts a different character, spanning The Rover in 2014 through Primetime and The Drama in 2026The set is made entirely from linden wood and stands 5.75 inches tallA24 is tracking its history with Robert Pattinson with a series of Nesting Dolls that stack six of his characters into a single linden wood set, tracing his work from 2014's The Rover to 2026's Primetime. Released as part of the studio's Primetime merchandise, the collectible turns one of modern cinema's most unpredictable filmographies into a hand-sized object you can open layer by layer.The build keeps things traditional. The set is crafted from 100% linden wood, a soft, fine-grained timber long favored for carving and for Russian matryoshka dolls in particular, and measures 5.75 inches tall. Each of the six figures represents a separate Pattinson role, so the act of unstacking the set becomes a walk through his career.The listing presents the lineup starting with Chris Hansen from Primetime (2026), suggesting he serves as the outermost doll. In the film, Pattinson plays the real-life television journalist Chris Hansen, best known for Dateline's To Catch a Predator segments. Next comes Charlie Thompson from The Drama (2026), the romantic dramedy that paired him with Zendaya.Further in, the dolls move through the run of films that reshaped Pattinson's reputation. There's Ephraim Winslow, who also goes by Thomas Howard, from The Lighthouse (2019), Robert Eggers' black-and-white fever dream opposite Willem Dafoe, and Monte from High Life (2018), Claire Denis' deep-space prison drama. Constantine "Connie" Nikas from the Safdie brothers' Good Time (2017) follows, with Reynolds "Rey" from David Michôd's The Rover (2014) at the core of the set.Taken together, the six characters map the period when Pattinson moved away from blockbuster franchise fame and toward auteur-driven, often deliberately unglamorous roles, a pivot that made him one of A24's most recognizable faces. Packing that arc into a matryoshka format fits the idea neatly: each performance sits inside the next, building into a single career-spanning object.The Robert Pattinson Nesting Dolls are available now as an early access preorder via the A24 Shop.Click here to view full gallery at Hypebeast
